password.why: With a password you can sign in with your mobile number and password, without waiting for an SMS code each time.
password.statusNone: You have no password yet. For now you sign in with a code only.
password.statusChanged: You have a password. Last changed: {date}.
password.codeFirst: For your security, we first send a code to your mobile.
password.otherDevices: Setting a password signs you out on all your other devices. You stay signed in on this browser.
password.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. It works for 5 minutes.
password.resendIn: You can resend the code in {seconds} seconds
password.ruleLength: At least {min} characters (Bangla, English, digits or symbols, any of them)
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.success: Your password is set. You can now sign in with your mobile number and password.
password.codeInvalid: The code is wrong, expired or already used. Send a new code and try again.

problem.TOO_COMMON: It is a very common password, easy to guess. Choose something else.
